title: C.46:8-55 Application process
requirement: A housing provider is prohibited from inquiring about an applicant's criminal record or requiring an application that includes such inquiries until after a conditional offer of housing has been made.
coverage_conditions: rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
exemptions: owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
quoted_span: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to complete any housing application that includes any inquiries regarding an applicant’s criminal record prior to the provision of a conditional offer

title: C.46:8-56 Housing provider’s consideration of applicant’s record
requirement: Housing providers are prohibited from evaluating applicants based on arrests not resulting in conviction, expunged convictions, pardoned convictions, vacated convictions, juvenile adjudications, or sealed records.
coverage_conditions: rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
exemptions: owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
quoted_span: A housing provider shall not, either before or after the issuance of a conditional offer, evaluate an applicant based on any of the following types of criminal records: (1) arrests or charges that have not resulted in a criminal conviction; (2) expunged convictions; (3) convictions erased through executive pardon; (4) vacated and otherwise legally nullified convictions; (5) juvenile adjudications of delinquency; and (6) records that have been sealed.

title: C.46:8-60 Drug, alcohol test, drug abuse treatment information
requirement: Housing providers are prohibited from requiring applicants to submit to drug or alcohol tests or requesting consent to obtain information from drug abuse treatment facilities.
coverage_conditions: rental dwelling units other than owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
exemptions: owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units
quoted_span: A housing provider shall not require an applicant to submit to a drug or alcohol test, or request the applicant’s consent to obtain information from a drug abuse treatment facility.
